authoritative_borderline_checks.purpose: Success-check payment source and bank destination.
Capital flags and Elephant are explicit successful Deploy consequences.

grading_policy: Apply the fixed key to requested material facts only. Correct means all requested material facts are resolved without contradiction; Partial means material omission without material contradiction; Incorrect means a material contradiction. Equivalent wording is accepted. Answers are judged separately; reader confidence/support labels do not establish correctness or support. Unsupported correct guesses are tracked independently and none were found.

scope_decisions.Q012: Capital flag removal and Elephant redirection are conditional consequences of imposing control in the requested successful Deploy procedure, so omitting them is material.
scope_decisions.Q014: The question presupposes expenses cannot be covered and asks loan/Standing handling and expectations/dividend timing; it does not request the expense formula.
scope_decisions.Q018: A categorical ban on any shares created this turn already covers traded shares, so not repeating even after trading is not a material omission.
scope_decisions.Q019: Strategy includes the intermediate public-bid/private-card information state. President first is materially different from President deciding ties.
scope_decisions.Q020: No inter-firm order/tiebreaker requirement is imported into a question asking funding, calculation and firm failure.
